def legendre_sequence(p):
    """Return Legendre sequence of prime length p, values in {-1, 1}."""
    seq = [0] * p
    seq[0] = 1  # by convention
    for i in range(1, p):
        # Legendre symbol (i/p)
        # For odd prime p, (i/p) = i^((p-1)/2) mod p, map to {-1,1}
        val = pow(i, (p-1)//2, p)
        if val == p - 1:
            val = -1
        seq[i] = val
    return seq

p = 23
x = legendre_sequence(p)
y = legendre_sequence(p)

print("x:", x)
print("sum x:", sum(x))
print("sum y:", sum(y))

def autocorr(seq, k):
    n = len(seq)
    return sum(seq[i] * seq[(i+k)%n] for i in range(n))

for k in range(1, 12):
    a_x = autocorr(x, k)
    a_y = autocorr(y, k)
    print(f"k={k}: A_x={a_x}, A_y={a_y}, sum={a_x+a_y}")

# concatenated
concat = x + y
